blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Health (DOH) on Friday said the risk of pneumonic plague in the Philippines remains “very low.” The health department made this observation as it monitors the investigation into the death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Russia. The department said the cause of the worker’s death in Russia has yet to be confirmed, noting that Russian authorities have not established a link between the fatality and the plague. “What is known so far is that the worker expired of pneumonia. The specific cause is still being investigated,” the DOH said. The World Health Organization (WHO) has assessed […]...
